tasks.title: Bounded identity-bound transport for operator-configured HTTP eval providers

acceptance.text: Real provider requests bind exact snapshot/suite/model and unique request IDs; pinned destination, separate credentials, no redirects, size/deadline/cancellation limits and malicious response handling pass. Transport is integrated into eval execution before adapter acceptance.

tasks.title: Scope parallel container cleanup assertions to their runner image

acceptance.text: Native/default and optional engine groups run concurrently without counting one another as leaks; cleanup still asserts no new containers for each immutable image. Failed CI attempt is retained and full CI reruns.

tasks.title: Immutable eval jobs and fenced per-trial recovery checkpoints

acceptance.text: Real PostgreSQL stages projected exact inputs and immutable units; concurrent claims, lease renewal/takeover, stale writers, normalized per-trial replay, cancellation and result immutability are tested. Restart resumes completed observations rather than rerunning or hiding them.

tasks.title: Credential-free Temporal evaluation worker and scoped database role

acceptance.text: Separate worker starts with no App/control secrets, only scoped eval database privileges and operator-pinned runner/provider configuration. Real Temporal activity retry, cancellation cleanup and replay are tested.

tasks.title: Recover containers left by process death using unit and lease ownership

acceptance.text: A killed worker leaves a real labeled container; the next fenced owner removes only prior containers for the same unit before resuming. Other units/services are untouched, stale owners cannot write, and cleanup failures cannot produce success.

tasks.title: Serialize repeatable schema and evaluator-role initialization

acceptance.text: Concurrent migration callers initialize a fresh dedicated test database without catalog/role races, retain exact schemas and grants, and repeat safely. Applicable full CI includes this test.

tasks.title: Stable per-unit trial request IDs and provider deduplication contract

acceptance.text: Real provider receives the same UUID for an interrupted uncommitted trial on retry, different IDs for distinct trials/units, and no request for retained observations. Provider deduplicates without double execution; mismatched payload reuse is rejected and invalid request IDs cannot dispatch. Scope and at-least-once limits are documented and full CI passes.

tasks.title: UBI eval worker runtime with pinned official Docker CLI and real image acceptance

acceptance.text: UBI non-root eval-worker image includes current stable official pinned Docker CLI, no package installers/controller credentials, and passes real restricted PostgreSQL/Temporal execution, child isolation, shutdown/restart and vulnerability scans. Applicable CI builds and verifies it; published native/download gates remain separately required.

tasks.title: Expose missing impact-required eval classes

acceptance.text: Tool changes without contract suites and permission/policy changes without policy or adversarial suites report explicit selection gaps, including through frozen-base comparison plans; unrelated changes do not fabricate gaps. Regression checks and full CI pass.

tasks.title: Identity-bound durable comparison evidence contract

acceptance.text: Strict comparison evidence binds organization/repository/PR/base/head/review/attempt and planned unit provenance, recomputes deltas/outcome, cannot pass missing or cancelled execution/coverage, exposes no projected source or credentials, and rejects forged identities/digests/summary. Real durable storage snapshot read and full CI verify it before API/PR integration.
